deck.title: From data foundation to financial investigation
deck.objective: An evidence-based analyst workflow with Oracle AI Data Platform, Autonomous AI Lakehouse and Oracle Analytics Cloud.

sections.heading:
From data foundation
to financial investigation
sections.subtitle: Oracle AI Data Platform • Meridian Demo Bank
sections.notes: Abhijit Khuperkar | 18 October 2026. Mixed business and technical audience. Follow one monthly investigation from portfolio context to account evidence and policy. Demonstration dataset; amounts shown in USD, a display assumption without FX conversion. No confirmed-fraud, calibrated-probability or realized-loss claim.

sections.heading: AI outcomes depend on data and workflow design
sections.subtitle: Two independent research findings; different survey populations

left: Lacked or were unsure of suitable data-management practices for AI.
right: Reported fundamental redesign of at least some workflows.

sections.notes: Gartner, 26 Feb 2025: https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-02-26-lack-of-ai-ready-data-puts-ai-projects-at-risk . McKinsey, 12 Mar 2025: https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai-how-organizations-are-rewiring-to-capture-value . These findings motivate explicit data contracts and workflow design; neither establishes causation or a measured benefit from this project. Do not invert adoption statistics into disconnected-workflow claims.

sections.heading: Make the serving paths explicit
sections.subtitle: Gold data supports analytics and a separate agent snapshot path
sections.notes: See docs/architecture.md and media/diagrams/architecture.svg. Actual implementation: Spark Delta finance Bronze/Silver/Gold; optional publication to native Oracle AILH tables consumed by OAC. Seven current agent SQL tools query finance.agent_demo_fs materialized Spark snapshots. Eight fictional policy documents feed RAG. Separate ML model predictions are not the agent queue input. Oracle SQL tool source options: https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/ai-data-platform/aidug/agent-flow-tools.html .

sections.heading: Curate data at the grain each decision needs
sections.subtitle: Spark and Delta medallion processing
sections.notes: Four public notebooks preserve the supplied code and markdown, with saved outputs cleared for publication. The separate random forest pipeline demonstrates fitting and evaluation with rule-derived labels: is_fraud = risk_score > 60, where score is randomly generated. Features exclude risk_score. No validated fraud-detection effectiveness follows; representative outcomes and independent model validation are required for a production claim. Source generator is unseeded, so rerun totals differ. Oracle overview: https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/ai-data-platform/aidug/overview-oracle-ai-data-platform.html .

sections.heading: Publish Gold with a verification contract
sections.subtitle: Autonomous AI Lakehouse is the analytical serving layer
sections.notes: Initial publication was verified after a wallet change, with schema, count, decimal, JSON and full-row duplicate-aware comparison. Changed-data replacement remains unvalidated after DATA_ACCESS_LAYER_0068. DDL includes CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; optional index DDL is supplied, not automatically executed by the catalog writer. Source tables remained unclustered when the runtime rejected retrofit ALTER clustering. See notebook appendix and docs/troubleshooting.md. External catalogs: https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/ai-data-platform/aidug/external-catalogs.html .

sections.heading: Start with a portfolio view; drill into evidence
sections.subtitle: December 2024 • USD OAC capture 18 October 2026
sections.notes: Reference data/reference-snapshot.json: 12,699 transactions, 4,436 active accounts; USD31,642,312.97 gross, USD20,071,594.45 net; 4,934 score>60 flags,38.853453027797464% count flag rate; USD12,547,752.55 flagged gross. Six AutoFit canvases: executive snapshot, executive brief, activity/risk trends, investigation queue, exposure breakdown, monthly changes. Whole-portfolio monthly comparisons are independent of account filters. Demonstration dataset; amounts shown in USD. Screening exposure is not confirmed fraud or loss. The screenshot is cropped, never reconstructed. The six OAC canvases were captured with USD presentation and rule FS-TRIAGE-1.1 on 18 October 2026. Original numeric reference remains 17 October; no amount rescaling.

sections.heading: Combine structured evidence with cited policy
sections.subtitle: Supervisor + four specialist executors • seven SQL tools + RAG + Prompt
sections.notes: Current node configurations and prompts are in agents/. Supervisor xai.grok-4.7; reference executor choices/settings are explicitly recorded there and may vary by tenant. Current Prompt tool argument: evidence_packet, String; it supersedes the earlier setup-notebook evidence_json template. Resolve the reporting period once, preserve snapshot/account scope, retrieve actual bounded evidence rows and applicable FS-POL-001 policy text. A risk_score is not a probability. No external-action tools or implemented approval gate. Guardrail and human-review language do not establish a technical authorization control.

sections.heading: Deploy once; keep client transports separate
sections.subtitle: Agent card → deployment → AI Registry → Agent Hub or local application
sections.notes: The author reports successful Agent Hub use and seven prompts. Exported trace covers root only. Historical Streamlit checks verified a signed card, minimal invocation and a SQL response. One hybrid follow-up completed transport but failed evidence reconciliation; fresh hosted acceptance is required. Do not show that prior answer as validated. No populated credentials, real endpoints or session histories are included. Run app from apps/copilot to load theme and secrets. Existing working PAF project is untouched.

sections.heading: Build the evidence before claiming the outcome
sections.subtitle: A reproducible path for a focused customer validation
sections.notes: Repository: https://github.com/akhuperkar/aidp-financial-investigation-copilot . User guide covers notebooks, OAC, Agent Builder, deployment and the client. Local mocked tests are distinct from hosted acceptance; the tenant CSV remains NOT_RUN until populated. Next: reconcile a fresh hybrid answer; validate changed-data publication; record the chapter sequence and add the final MP4 via Git LFS. Suggested value measurement: time to assemble a review packet and verification rework. These have not been measured by this project. Video and Medium URLs remain pending publication.
